samples.question: Four panels P1, P2, P3 and P4 are shown left to right in order. Each panel is a horizontal track with a marked half-way line and a left-aligned level bar whose length is the running amount in a tank. The tank starts at a base amount; then for each successive panel one signed step (add or remove) is applied, so panel Pk shows the level after the first k steps -- the bar in each panel grows or shrinks accordingly. Report the panel in which the running level FIRST rises strictly above the marked half-way line. If no panel ever rises above it, answer 'never'. Answer with exactly one of: P1, P2, P3, P4, never.
